blocks.zh: Part 600：設施標準、記錄、偏差報告與不良事件
blocks.en: Part 600: Facility Standards, Records, Deviation Reporting and Adverse Experiences

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握 Part 600 中設施人員（600.10）、記錄（600.12）、留樣（600.13）的具體要求
blocks.en: Master the specific requirements of Part 600 for facility personnel (600.10), records (600.12) and retention samples (600.13)

blocks.zh: 理解生物製品偏差報告（600.14）的觸發條件、45 天時限、報告對象及表單
blocks.en: Understand the triggers, the 45-day deadline, the recipient and the form for biological product deviation reporting (600.14)

blocks.zh: 了解上市後不良事件報告（600.80）的分級（15 天緊急 vs 定期）與記錄保存義務
blocks.en: Understand the classification of postmarketing adverse experience reports (600.80) (15-day alert vs periodic) and the record retention obligations

blocks.zh: 識別 Part 600 義務在 CDMO 合約製造架構下如何分配責任
blocks.en: Identify how Part 600 obligations are allocated between the parties in a CDMO contract manufacturing arrangement

blocks.en: 1.1 Key Definitions (§ 600.3)

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 批次 (Lot) 定義的法規意涵： 「在單一容器中均勻混合」是批次的核心——這決定了哪些充填是「同批次」，進而決定批次放行測試的範圍和留樣要求。CDMO 若分兩次充填同一原液，如果原液未重新混勻，技術上可能是不同批次。
blocks.en: Regulatory implications of the definition of a lot: The core of a lot is that the material is "uniformly mixed in a single container." This determines which fills count as the "same lot," and in turn the scope of lot release testing and retention sample requirements. If a CDMO fills the same bulk drug substance in two separate runs and the bulk is not re-mixed, these may technically be different lots.

blocks.zh: Distributed（已配送）的觸發點： 產品一旦「離開製造商控制」就算已配送。這個時間點是偏差報告 45 天計時的關鍵——即便產品還在客戶倉庫，已超出 CDMO 的 direct control 範圍。
blocks.en: The trigger point for "Distributed": A product counts as distributed as soon as it leaves the manufacturer's control. This point in time is the key to the 45-day deviation reporting clock, even if the product is still in the client's warehouse, because it is already outside the CDMO's direct control.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: ★ Part 600 的定義是整個 Subchapter F 的法律基礎詞彙表。理解這些定義對於解讀後續各 Part 的義務邊界至關重要。
blocks.en: ★ The Part 600 definitions are the legal vocabulary for the whole of Subchapter F. Understanding them is essential to interpreting the boundaries of the obligations in the later Parts.

blocks.zh: ★「Manufacture（製造）」在法規中的定義包含「充填、測試、標籤、包裝、儲存」——意思是 CDMO 承接充填業務就算在「製造」，必須遵守所有相關 GMP 要求。
blocks.en: ★ The regulatory definition of "manufacture" covers filling, testing, labeling, packaging and storage. A CDMO that takes on filling is therefore "manufacturing" and must comply with all relevant GMP requirements.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 如果兩批原液（DS lot A 和 DS lot B）分別充填，在 Part 600 定義下，這算一個批次還是兩個批次？
blocks.en: If two bulk drug substance lots (DS lot A and DS lot B) are filled separately, is this one lot or two lots under the Part 600 definitions?

blocks.zh: 「充填包裝」服務商是否算 Part 600 定義下的「製造商 (manufacturer)」？
blocks.en: Is a "fill-finish" service provider a "manufacturer" under the Part 600 definitions?

blocks.zh: 1.2 Personnel Standards (§ 600.10) 1.2 人員標準（§ 600.10）
blocks.en: 1.2 Personnel Standards (§ 600.10)

blocks.zh: 人員能力要求 vs 培訓記錄： 600.10 要求的不只是「完成培訓課程」，而是真正理解並能執行製造操作。FDA 查廠時會問操作員問題來驗證實質理解——培訓記錄只是基礎，現場實際能力才是重點。
blocks.en: Competence vs training records: 600.10 requires not just "completion of training courses" but real understanding and the ability to carry out manufacturing operations. During inspections, FDA questions operators to verify genuine understanding; training records are only the baseline, and actual competence on the floor is what matters.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: c(4) 的活疫苗區要求是最嚴格的隔離版本。想像一個廚師早上處理過生雞肉（病原體），下午不能直接進去準備刺身（無菌區）——必須完全更換衣物和鞋子，甚至當天不能進入某些區域。
blocks.en: The live vaccine area requirement in (c)(4) is the strictest form of segregation. Imagine a chef who handled raw chicken (a pathogen source) in the morning: in the afternoon he cannot go straight in to prepare sashimi (a sterile area). He must change clothing and shoes completely, and may not even enter certain areas that day.

blocks.zh: ★ 對於生物製品 CDMO：如果廠房同時生產病毒疫苗和非病毒生物製品，人員的交叉管制（c)(3)(4)）必須在 SOP 中明確規定，並有記錄可追溯。這是 FDA BPBIA 查廠的常見觀察項。
blocks.en: ★ For a biologics CDMO: if the facility makes both viral vaccines and non-viral biological products, the cross-restrictions on personnel ((c)(3) and (c)(4)) must be clearly specified in SOPs, with traceable records. This is a common observation in FDA biologics inspections.

blocks.zh: ★「commensurate with their assigned functions」意味著不同崗位需要不同層級的能力驗證——充填操作員的培訓課程不等於製程開發科學家的要求。
blocks.en: ★ "Commensurate with their assigned functions" means that different positions require different levels of competence verification: the training program for a filling operator is not the same as the requirements for a process development scientist.

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠時如何驗證 600.10 的合規性？你會如何準備？
blocks.en: How does FDA verify compliance with 600.10 during an inspection? How would you prepare?

blocks.zh: CDMO 廠房中，哪些人員崗位最可能面對 c(3) 或 c(4) 的限制？
blocks.en: Which personnel positions in a CDMO facility are most likely to face the restrictions in (c)(3) or (c)(4)?

blocks.zh: 1.3 Records & Retention Samples (§§ 600.12–600.13) 1.3 紀錄與留樣（§§ 600.12–600.13）
blocks.en: 1.3 Records & Retention Samples (§§ 600.12–600.13)

blocks.zh: 同步記錄原則 (Concurrent recording)：「Concurrently with the performance」是數據完整性（Data Integrity）的核心——不允許操作完成後追記，不允許預先填寫，不允許事後更改原始資料而不留修改痕跡。這個要求在 600.12 就明確寫入，與 ALCOA+ 原則完全一致。
blocks.en: Concurrent recording: "Concurrently with the performance" is the core of data integrity. Records may not be added after the operation is complete, filled in in advance, or have original data changed afterwards without leaving a trace of the change. This requirement is written explicitly into 600.12 and is fully consistent with the ALCOA+ principles.

blocks.zh: 可追溯性 (Traceability)： 記錄必須讓查廠者能「沿著時間順序追蹤每個步驟」——這要求 CDMO 的批次記錄（Batch Record）系統必須建立清晰的製造步驟串聯索引。
blocks.en: Traceability: Records must allow an inspector to "follow each step in chronological order." This requires the CDMO's batch record system to have a clear index linking the manufacturing steps together.

blocks.zh: ★ 留樣（Retention samples）的保存條件和保存期限必須在 SOP 中定義，且符合 BLA 中批准的條件。如果是溫度敏感的生物製品，必須有連續溫度監控記錄來證明留樣整個保存期間的完整性。
blocks.en: ★ The storage conditions and retention period for retention samples must be defined in an SOP and comply with the conditions approved in the BLA. For temperature-sensitive biological products, continuous temperature monitoring records must demonstrate the integrity of the samples throughout the retention period.

blocks.zh: ★「legible and indelible」意味著：不可使用鉛筆；電子記錄必須有稽核追蹤（Audit Trail）且不可刪除原始條目。
blocks.en: ★ "Legible and indelible" means: no pencil; electronic records must have an audit trail and original entries must not be deletable.

blocks.zh: 如果操作員在充填結束後 2 小時才記錄批次記錄，這是否違反 600.12？如何在 CAPA 中解決？
blocks.en: If an operator completes the batch record 2 hours after filling ends, does this violate 600.12? How would you resolve it in a CAPA?

blocks.zh: CDMO 的留樣義務是否由 CDMO 承擔，還是可以委託客戶（BLA 持有人）？
blocks.en: Is the retention sample obligation borne by the CDMO, or can it be delegated to the client (the BLA holder)?

blocks.zh: 1.4 Biological Product Deviation Reporting (§ 600.14) 1.4 生物製品偏差報告（§ 600.14）
blocks.en: 1.4 Biological Product Deviation Reporting (§ 600.14)

blocks.zh: 600.14 vs 21 CFR 314.81（NDA 偏差報告）： 生物製品有自己的偏差報告機制（600.14），與藥品的 Field Alert Report (FAR) 是分開的。報告對象是 CBER 或 CDER，使用 Form FDA-3486（不是 Form FDA 3331a）。
blocks.en: 600.14 vs 21 CFR 314.81 (NDA deviation reporting): Biological products have their own deviation reporting mechanism (600.14), separate from the Field Alert Report (FAR) for drugs. Reports go to CBER or CDER using Form FDA-3486 (not Form FDA 3331a).

blocks.zh: 45 天計時起點： 從「取得足以合理推斷可報告事件已發生的資訊」之日起算——不是偏差確認後，而是初步資訊取得後就開始計時。這意味著內部調查必須在 45 天窗口內完成。
blocks.en: Start of the 45-day clock: The clock runs from the date on which you acquire information reasonably suggesting that a reportable event has occurred. It starts not when the deviation is confirmed but as soon as the initial information is obtained. This means the internal investigation must be completed within the 45-day window.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的角色： 偏差報告義務屬於 BLA 持有人（通常是客戶）。但 CDMO 必須在品質協議中定義：CDMO 在多少天內通知客戶（通常是 3–5 天），讓客戶有足夠時間在 45 天內完成調查並提交 FDA-3486。
blocks.en: The CDMO's role: The deviation reporting obligation belongs to the BLA holder (usually the client). But the CDMO must define in the Quality Agreement within how many days it will notify the client (typically 3–5 days), so that the client has enough time to complete the investigation and submit Form FDA-3486 within 45 days.

blocks.zh: 想像 CDMO 是「代工廠」，客戶（BLA 持有人）是「品牌商」。如果代工廠發生問題，品牌商必須對外（對 FDA）負責。但品牌商只有知道了才能報告——所以代工合約必須確保資訊流轉速度，不能讓資訊在 CDMO 內部「卡住」。
blocks.en: Imagine the CDMO as the "contract manufacturer" and the client (BLA holder) as the "brand owner." If the contract manufacturer has a problem, the brand owner is answerable to the outside world (to FDA). But the brand owner can only report what it knows, so the contract must ensure information flows quickly and never gets "stuck" inside the CDMO.

blocks.zh: ★ 觸發條件包括「unexpected or unforeseeable events」——這意味著就算事件結果良好（如偏差經調查後確認對產品無影響），只要符合「影響 safety/purity/potency」的可能性評估，就應評估是否需要報告。
blocks.en: ★ The triggers include "unexpected or unforeseeable events." This means that even where the outcome is good (for example, an investigation confirms the deviation had no effect on the product), if there is a possibility of affecting safety, purity or potency you should still assess whether a report is needed.

blocks.zh: ★ 已配送（distributed）產品的偏差特別需要重視——一旦產品在患者手上，偏差報告可能觸發藥品召回（Recall）決策，影響遠超過未配送批次。
blocks.en: ★ Deviations involving distributed products need particular attention. Once the product is in patients' hands, a deviation report can trigger a recall decision, with far greater impact than for undistributed lots.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: Amaran 承接某 mAb 充填業務，充填完成後客戶已提走部分批次（已配送）。此時發現環境監測（EM）出現超標（OOS result）。根據 600.14：(1) CDMO 必須立即通知客戶（BLA 持有人）；(2) 客戶必須評估此 EM OOS 是否構成影響已配送產品安全性/純度/效力的偏差；(3) 若符合，客戶必須在 45 天內向 CBER 提交 Form FDA-3486。CDMO 的品質協議應明確要求 CDMO 在 48 小時內通知客戶任何可能觸發 600.14 的事件。
blocks.en: Amaran takes on a mAb filling project, and after filling is complete the client has already collected some lots (distributed). An environmental monitoring (EM) excursion (OOS result) is then discovered. Under 600.14: (1) the CDMO must notify the client (BLA holder) immediately; (2) the client must assess whether this EM OOS constitutes a deviation affecting the safety, purity or potency of the distributed product; (3) if so, the client must submit Form FDA-3486 to CBER within 45 days. The CDMO's Quality Agreement should expressly require the CDMO to notify the client within 48 hours of any event that may trigger 600.14.

blocks.zh: 1.5 Postmarketing Adverse Experience Reporting (§ 600.80) 1.5 上市後不良經驗報告（§ 600.80）
blocks.en: 1.5 Postmarketing Adverse Experience Reporting (§ 600.80)

blocks.zh: Serious AND Unexpected（雙重條件）觸發 15 天報告： 「嚴重（Serious）」指危及生命、需住院、致殘、先天異常、其他重要醫學事件；「意外（Unexpected）」指現行核准標籤中未列出的不良反應。兩個條件同時滿足才觸發 15 天緊急報告。
blocks.en: Serious AND unexpected (dual condition) triggers a 15-day report: "Serious" means life-threatening, requiring hospitalization, resulting in disability, congenital anomaly, or another important medical event; "unexpected" means an adverse reaction not listed in the currently approved labeling. A 15-day alert report is triggered only when both conditions are met.

blocks.zh: 10 年記錄保存： 相比一般藥品記錄保存（通常 2–3 年），生物製品的不良事件記錄需保存 10 年，反映了生物製品安全監控的長期性要求。
blocks.en: 10-year record retention: Compared with the general retention of drug records (usually 2–3 years), adverse experience records for biological products must be kept for 10 years, reflecting the long-term nature of safety monitoring for biologics.

blocks.zh: ★ 600.80 的義務在 BLA 持有人（客戶）身上，不在 CDMO——但 CDMO 若透過客戶投訴或其他渠道收到不良事件報告，必須立即轉達客戶。品質協議應明確投訴轉發時限（通常 1–3 個工作日）。
blocks.en: ★ The 600.80 obligations rest with the BLA holder (the client), not the CDMO. But if the CDMO receives an adverse event report through client complaints or other channels, it must forward it to the client immediately. The Quality Agreement should specify the complaint forwarding time limit (usually 1–3 working days).

blocks.zh: ★ 文獻監控（scientific literature monitoring）是 600.80 的重要組成——BLA 持有人必須監控公開發表的研究文獻，以識別可能的新安全信號。
blocks.en: ★ Scientific literature monitoring is an important part of 600.80: the BLA holder must monitor published literature to identify possible new safety signals.

blocks.zh: 一個生物製品上市後，有患者在 Twitter 上報告可能的嚴重不良事件，這是否需要啟動 15 天報告流程？
blocks.en: After a biological product is marketed, a patient reports a possible serious adverse event on Twitter. Does this require starting the 15-day reporting process?

blocks.zh: CDMO 在不良事件報告義務中的角色是什麼？品質協議應如何定義？
blocks.en: What is the CDMO's role in adverse experience reporting obligations? How should the Quality Agreement define it?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 600.10 人員要求涵蓋能力、培訓、及不同製造區域的人員管控——無菌操作和活疫苗區有最嚴格的隔離要求
blocks.en: The 600.10 personnel requirements cover competence, training and personnel control across manufacturing areas; aseptic operations and live vaccine areas have the strictest segregation requirements

blocks.zh: 600.12 的同步記錄原則是數據完整性的法規基礎，不允許事後追記或修改原始記錄
blocks.en: The concurrent recording principle in 600.12 is the regulatory foundation of data integrity; records may not be added or original records altered after the fact

blocks.zh: 600.14 生物製品偏差報告：BLA 持有人義務，45 天計時，Form FDA-3486；CDMO 必須在品質協議中定義通知客戶的時限
blocks.en: 600.14 biological product deviation reporting: an obligation of the BLA holder, 45-day clock, Form FDA-3486; the CDMO must define in the Quality Agreement the time limit for notifying the client

blocks.zh: 600.80 上市後不良事件：嚴重且意外 → 15 天報告；定期報告（季/年）；記錄保存 10 年
blocks.en: 600.80 postmarketing adverse experiences: serious and unexpected → 15-day report; periodic reports (quarterly/annual); records retained for 10 years
